messages:
Maya Lin: Heads-up: onboarding client 'ClearHarbor' pilot in APAC. They see 403s when calling callbacks. Customer suspects our egress IPs are blocked. They asked for inbound allowlist of their proxy IPs on our edges + temporary QPS bump scoped to ap-southeast-1 for a 48h trial. Renewal discussion depends on pilot success.
Connor Blake: Can we get the IP list and target QPS?
Maya Lin: IPs: 103.5.140.0/24, 203.76.12.34, 45.120.0.0/20. QPS request: 200 -> 1000 for 48h. Region: ap-southeast-1 only.
Connor Blake: Risk assessment: inbound allowlist OK. Rate lift: needs auto-revoke, model pin, and isolation. Recommend model:gptx-4k shard, qps 1000, window 48h, auto-revoke true, circuit-breaker p95 900ms.
Rina Shah: Billing: they're on a small enterprise trial with credits; flag finance for possible overage invoice. Also capture CS feedback: they want clearer guidance on one-click allowlist in docs.
Maya Lin: I'll coordinate enablement and ask SE to run a smoke after change.
Connor Blake: Applying changes now: 
```
rbw ops apply-allowlist --customer clearharbor --direction inbound --ips "103.5.140.0/24,203.76.12.34,45.120.0.0/20" --region ap-southeast-1 --expires "2025-01-15T22:00:00Z"
rbw ops set-rate-policy --customer clearharbor --region ap-southeast-1 --model gptx-4k --qps 1000 --window 48h --auto-revoke true
```
ops-bot: apply-allowlist accepted (req id a7b3).
ops-bot: rate-policy queued (policy id rp-1138).
ops-bot: allowlist applied  rule id al-8811  scope inbound ap-southeast-1  expires 2025-01-15T22:00:00Z.
ops-bot: rate-policy active  policy rp-1138  qps 1000  window 48h  auto-revoke true.
Maya Lin: Running smoke now and asked ClearHarbor to run parallel tests.
Maya Lin: Smoke: 10/10 success, no 403s, p95 420ms.
Rina Shah: Noted. I'll add renewal playbook: reach out 48h before revoke to discuss committed capacity and pricing. Capture request for improved docs and an allowlist CTA in console.
Connor Blake: Added monitoring alert: error-rate >1% or p95 >900ms during window; auto-roll back if tripped.
Maya Lin: Thanks. I'll update the ticket and schedule a day-1 check-in. ops-bot: revoke-check scheduled at 2025-01-15T22:05:00Z for policy rp-1138.
